statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete. The host is a genuine single-page static infrastructure disclaimer; external surveza.ai legal documents were not treated as templates of cdn.33apk.com.

page.notes: Static, server-rendered disclaimer/abuse-contact page. robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404; all navigable HTTP links leave the audited host, so homepage-only coverage is explicit and representative.

paths.description: Root disclaimer page, the only same-host public content archetype found. Covers purpose, support contact, policy links, responsive presentation, crawler output, performance, privacy, security, accessibility, and static memory footprint. Not covered: off-host surveza.ai legal pages and unknown generated survey URLs because they are different origins/templates and no same-host routes were discoverable.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical in layout and palette to the light capture; the computed CSS probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() support.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens for the page, card, text, links, and accent surface.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is deliberately removed from links.
findings.evidence: The focused Terms link computed to outline-style none and no box shadow; the stylesheet includes :focus { outline: 0 } and a:hover/a:active outline removal without a :focus-visible replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove global focus-outline suppression and add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring with adequate offset; preserve non-hover cues and verify target size.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good Core Web Vitals threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 2.8 s (good is at most 2.5 s) and FCP at 2.5 s, while the first-party trace measured LCP 1.15 s on an unthrottled run.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the critical path by self-hosting/subsetting the font, inlining or consolidating critical CSS, and deferring non-essential third-party work.

findings.summary: Render-blocking styles and a remote font delay first render.
findings.evidence: HAR identified three parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets; DOM confirms they are synchronous head links. Lighthouse estimates 1,740 ms render-blocking savings and 76 KiB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline minimal critical CSS, consolidate local CSS, self-host/subset the font with a resilient fallback, and set durable immutable caching for versioned assets.

findings.summary: Analytics dominates JavaScript delivery on a static disclaimer page.
findings.evidence: Yandex Metrika tag.js transfers about 90 KiB, 58% of the entire 156 KiB load; Lighthouse reports about 47 KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove session-wide analytics from this static page or load a minimal, consent-gated measurement path after the core content and user choice.

findings.summary: A dynamically injected tracking image has no text alternative or presentational role.
findings.evidence: axe reports a critical image-alt violation for body > img; the image primitive also found the injected 1×1 GIF without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark tracking pixels alt="" and role="presentation" (or remove them); retain meaningful alt text for content images.

findings.summary: Small gray body text fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe found nine 12 px text/link nodes at #7d7d7d on white with a 4.11:1 ratio, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken secondary text to achieve at least 4.5:1 and retest normal, dark, and high-contrast conditions.

findings.summary: The page has no heading structure and keyboard focus is invisible.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found no h1-h6 elements; axe flags page-has-heading-one, and the focus probe found outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive h1 and logical subordinate headings, and restore a visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags unsized images and the image primitive reports missing width/height on the logo and injected tracking image; a measured mobile CLS of 0.041 corroborates small late movement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width and height to the logo and any retained pixel image so space is reserved before fetch completion.

findings.summary: Chrome reports inspector issues during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s inspector-issues audit scored 0; the same run also reports third-party-cookie issues associated with the tracking stack.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect and resolve the DevTools Issues entries, prioritising third-party-cookie and tracker-related warnings.

findings.summary: Search metadata does not describe the page.
findings.evidence: The title is only “Surveza” and there is no meta description; Lighthouse fails meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Write a specific title such as “Survey landing-page infrastructure | Surveza” and a concise description matching the disclaimer.

findings.summary: The public page lacks canonical, robots, and sitemap signals.
findings.evidence: The page returns 200 and is indexable, but the probe found no canonical; /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return generic nginx 404 pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical and publish intentional robots.txt and sitemap.xml responses consistent with the desired indexing policy.

findings.summary: The organization/disclaimer page has no share preview or structured metadata.
findings.evidence: The probe found zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite the page representing the Surveza organization and infrastructure purpose.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter metadata and minimal Organization/WebPage JSON-LD that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Browser security policy headers are materially incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and nosniff are present, but CSP, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are absent; HSTS is only max-age=1.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors), long-lived HSTS after rollout validation, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: A static disclaimer loads extensive session analytics and cookie synchronisation without an on-page choice.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 15 of 21 requests and 125,587 of 156,021 bytes are third-party; Yandex Webvisor is enabled, five third-party origins load, and four SameSite=None analytics cookies are set.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable Webvisor and cookie syncing by default, minimise measurement, gate non-essential analytics on explicit consent where required, and document each retained processor.

findings.summary: Missing routes return a dead-end server error page.
findings.evidence: Both /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml returned the generic nginx 404 document with no branding, explanation, home link, or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an intentional lightweight 404 page with a clear explanation and links back to the root and support contact.

findings.summary: Third-party tracking is disproportionate to this static page’s user value.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 80% of transferred bytes; the 90 KiB Yandex script alone outweighs all first-party content threefold and initiates redirects and background requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential trackers, defer any justified telemetry, and set a strict third-party request/byte budget for this static surface.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference does not improve already marginal text contrast.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more capture preserves the normal palette, while axe measures the secondary 12 px text at only 4.11:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-contrast: more treatment that increases secondary-text and focus-indicator contrast, and verify forced-colors behavior.
